doc_type.description: Document classification: resolution_plan_order, interim_order, admission_order, liquidation_order, nclt_order, nclat_order, appeal_order, petition, information_memorandum, other

case_number.description: NCLT/NCLAT case number e.g. IB-761(ND)/2022 or CP(IB)/123/MB/2021

court.description: Full court/tribunal name and bench e.g. National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), New Delhi Bench

order_date.description: Date of order in YYYY-MM-DD format

judges.description: Full names and designations of judges/members on the bench

corporate_debtor.description: Full legal name of the corporate debtor company (CIN if mentioned)

resolution_applicant.description: Full name of the successful resolution applicant (SRA)

insolvency_professional.description: Full name of the Resolution Professional (RP) or Interim RP

petition_type.description: IBC petition section: Section 7 (financial creditor), Section 9 (operational creditor), Section 10 (corporate debtor)

admission_date.description: Date when NCLT admitted the petition in YYYY-MM-DD

parties.description: All parties with roles e.g. 'State Bank of India (Financial Creditor)'

resolution_amount_inr.description: Total resolution plan amount in INR integer (no commas/symbols). E.g. 506700000 for ₹50.67 crore

liquidation_value_inr.description: Liquidation value of corporate debtor assets in INR integer

fair_value_inr.description: Fair value of corporate debtor assets in INR integer

total_admitted_inr.description: Total claims admitted by RP across all creditor classes in INR integer

upfront_inr.description: Upfront payment amount on approval/closing day in INR integer

payment_timeline_months.description: Total payment timeline in months from plan approval

coc_approval_pct.description: CoC vote percentage in favour of resolution plan. Must be >= 66% per Section 30(4)

cirp_cost_inr.description: Total CIRP process costs / resolution professional fees in INR integer

section_29a_compliant.description: Whether the resolution applicant was confirmed eligible under Section 29A

creditors.description: All creditors with their admitted claims and plan recovery
